stil: Highly detailed 3D animated render in the style of a premium educational science animation, cinematic dramatic lighting, vivid colors, clean realistic materials with subtle subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, scientifically accurate anatomy, vertical composition with the main subject large and centered. No text, no letters, no labels, no arrows, no watermark, no logo.

gorseller.istem: Dark honeycomb seen from above: one worker honey bee in the center (golden-brown striped abdomen raised, six legs, two pairs of clear wings folded on its back, two antennae). Around her five other honey bees stand in a ring, all heads and antennae pointing at her. On the comb in front of her a single continuous glowing golden line forms a large clean figure-eight: two equal round loops that cross once in the middle, the whole shape inside the frame.
gorseller.not: Dans eden işçi arı ortada, çizdiği sekiz şekli parlayan ışık izi. Etrafında halka olmuş izleyici arılar. Altı bacak, iki çift kanat. | 2. tur (28 Kas): görsel denetçi istem düzeltmesi.

gorseller.istem: Top-down close-up of a realistic worker honey bee (Apis mellifera: golden-brown fuzzy thorax, abdomen with alternating dark brown and amber stripes, big dark brown compound eyes, six legs, two pairs of transparent wings) dancing on a golden honeycomb, abdomen raised and wagging, motion blur on the tip of the abdomen, wings folded over her back, other bees blurred around her, warm amber light. The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Dansçı arı: karın kalkık, sallanıyor, kanatlar sırtta, altı bacak.

gorseller.istem: Close-up inside a hive: three worker bees on a golden honeycomb with their heads and antennae pointed toward one center point, as if watching a dancer, warm amber light, shallow depth of field. The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Birkaç işçi arı başlarını merkeze çevirmiş; altın-kahve çizgili, altı bacak.

gorseller.istem: Vertical cinematic view of a sunlit flower meadow at golden hour with the bright sun low on the horizon at the left, long soft sun rays, a patch of purple flowers in the distance, tall grass in the foreground, empty of animals.

The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Uçan bal arısı: iki çift kanat, altı bacak, çizgili karın.
